verdict: NetApp posted record revenue of $2.0B, up 30%, as all-flash storage sales surged 47% on AI demand — and it raised its full-year guidance after beating on every metric.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP diluted)
kpis.note: vs $1.15 a year ago; non-GAAP EPS was a record $2.58

segments.name: Hybrid Cloud
segments.note: Storage systems and software customers run in their own data centers — including the record $1.3B of all-flash array revenue, up 47% as companies build for AI.

segments.name: Public Cloud
segments.note: NetApp storage services sold inside Amazon, Microsoft and Google's clouds — a record $206M, up 28%.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling storage systems and cloud services — NetApp's biggest running cost.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the storage platform and its AI data-infrastructure products.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day.

opex.name: Restructuring charges
opex.note: One-off costs of a restructuring program — up from just $2M a year ago (see one-time items).

otherDetail: Other expense was $0M this quarter — interest and other items netted to exactly nothing, so pre-tax income equaled operating income.
follow100Note: Rows may add to $99.99 or $100.01 due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Hardware is booming again
takeaways.text: Product revenue jumped 51% to $987M as customers bought all-flash arrays for AI workloads; services revenue rose 15% to $1,038M. Total revenue was a record $2,025M, up 30%.

takeaways.title: GAAP profit understates the run-rate
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS was $1.88, but non-GAAP EPS — excluding stock-based pay, restructuring and similar items — was a record $2.58, and non-GAAP net income was $515M vs $375M GAAP.

takeaways.title: Guidance raised for the year
takeaways.text: NetApp raised its fiscal 2027 revenue guidance to $7,975–$8,225M (about $8.1B at the midpoint) and guided Q2 FY27 revenue to $2,025–$2,175M.

oneTimers: $56M of restructuring charges sit inside GAAP operating expenses (vs $2M a year ago). NetApp's non-GAAP figures exclude them, along with stock-based compensation and intangible amortization.
footerNote: NetApp's fiscal year ends in late April, so this is Q1 of fiscal 2027 — the quarter ended July 31, 2026 — its most recent reported quarter as of November 7, 2026 (Q2 FY27 results were due in late November 2026).
